steps.detail: Named fictitious study created; objectives, fixed inputs and unknowns recorded below.
Crossing outline refused; corrected 120×100 m boundary accepted and copied into locked residential inputs.
Named 12m south external road entered before internal roads/lots; no camera workaround.
South entrance chosen at 60m and locked as an input commitment; no invented additional entrance.
Exact five-corner woodland and provisional 2m envelope retained, locked, no crossings.
268m² recreation, minimum250m², exact stored NW region and required future road access saved; not claimed as completed usable park.
Compact6×12 and Family8×16; original ±10% dimensions, ±20% area, saleable maxima86.4/153.6, irregular permission and rear ratio0.7.
Mandatory60/40 by valid unit count, tolerance±5 percentage points; integer counts drive actual shares.
8m provisional corridor; separate carriageway, radii/returns, vehicle and approval inputs remain unresolved.
Prepare Layout produced connected real roads/lots servicing the original park, with explicit dead-end choice and no hidden relaxation.
Proposed quantity differences inspected; accepted state preserved until complete acceptance.
Full corridors/connections measured and no geometric failure; approved vehicle turning and engineering remain unresolved.
Deliberate street sections generate both opposing products coherently.
Interior/corner/curved lot screening also verified in dedicated mixed-radius and invalid equal-area regressions; house fit remains external.
Locked entrance refused movement; permitted entrance mouse movement and complete history verified in separate original-fixture replay.
Street/bend movement and mixed-radius loops verified in dedicated visible-editor regression and original-fixture replay.
Whole street section product changed; regenerated proposal inspected then cancelled, keeping original mix/products.
Temporary depth13m proposal regenerated and limits reviewed; cancelled so final products remain fixed6×12/8×16.
Retained passing28-lot whole-section rebalance feedback verified separately; target/count arithmetic reconciled on this generated plan.
Existing-product residual trials and constraint explanations inspected; already-tested state is explained without inventing products or parks.
Isolated flexible-space edge change touches occupied lot land; regenerated lots or explicit conflict recorded, commitments and protection retained.
Fixed12000m² reconciles; junction overlaps counted once, external road excluded from internal roads; independent arithmetic audit follows exports.
Scoped fictitious lot connections plus road civil works priced from current valid counts/area; unpriced space works remain explicit.
Independent alternatives retained and compared using identical viewBox/graphic conventions.
Conditional shortlist and trade-off reasons saved; unknown engineering/approval checks prevent an unconditional preferred or global-optimum claim.
Save/reopen and portable fresh-profile import exact; curve/mouse complete undo/redo and cancellation verified separately.
